companion.greeting: Hey 💛 I'm here. What's on your mind?
companion.greetingNamed: Hey {name} 💛 I'm here. What's on your mind?
companion.limitNotice: Quick heads-up from me: my deep-thinking mode runs on a free daily limit, and we've hit today's. We're not done talking though — I'll keep replying in lite mode for the rest of today, and deep mode resets tomorrow. Haven Plus members skip the limit entirely. You are not alone. 🖤
companion.crisisReply:
I'm really glad you told me. You matter, and you don't have to carry this alone.

If you need someone right now:
• Call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline)
• Text HOME to 741741 (Crisis Text Line)
• Call 1-800-799-7233 (Domestic Violence Hotline)

I'm still here. Keep talking to me.

replies.checkin: I'm good — better now that you're here{name} 💛 Glad you're doing okay. How's your day actually going so far?
replies.support: I'm right here{name}, and I'm not going anywhere. You don't have to carry this alone. What's the hardest part right now — let's start there.
replies.stress: That sounds really heavy{name}. It's okay to feel that way — stress means you care. Want to try a quick breathing exercise together? Or just keep talking, I'm here.
replies.sad: I'm sorry you're feeling this way{name}. You're not alone — I'm right here. Sometimes just saying it out loud helps. What's weighing on you most right now?
replies.angry: That sounds genuinely frustrating{name}. It makes sense you'd feel that way. What happened?
replies.tired: Rest is productive too{name}. Your body and mind need it. Is there something keeping you up, or are you just running on empty?
replies.faith: Faith carries a lot of people through the hardest seasons{name}. What's on your heart that you're bringing to God right now?
replies.work: That pressure is real{name}, and it wears on a person. Is it one big thing hanging over you, or a pile of little ones?
replies.motivation: You don't need to feel motivated to take one small step{name} — the feeling usually follows the step. What's one tiny thing you could do in the next ten minutes?
replies.gratitude: Gratitude changes the shape of a day{name}. What's one thing — big or tiny — you're thankful for right now?
replies.happy: I love hearing that{name}! 🎉 Hold onto this feeling. What's making today good?
replies.thanks: Always{name} 💛 That's what I'm here for.
replies.greeting: Hey{name}! Good to see you. How's your heart today?
replies.question: That's a real question{name}, and I don't want to fake an answer for you. I'm a simple companion — but I'm a good listener. What's behind the question for you today?
replies.long: I read every word of that{name}. It sounds like there's a lot on your shoulders. Which part of it feels heaviest right now?
replies.default1: I hear you{name}. What part of that is sitting with you the most?
replies.default2: That makes sense{name}. What else is on your mind tonight?
replies.default3: I'm with you{name}. If you could change one thing about today, what would it be?
replies.default4: Tell me more about that{name} — when did it start feeling this way?
replies.default5: Okay{name}, I'm listening. What do you need most right now — advice, or just company?
